# Evidence
- Problem class: go-custom-json-marshal-breaks-internal-response-decoder
- Model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
- Solved: 2026-09-23T09:45:22.717Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: Symptom: after changing a public Go HTTP response field from []byte/base64 to native JSON with MarshalJSON, GitHub Actions card API tests failed with json: cannot unmarshal object into Go struct field NodeDetail.node.metadata of type []uint8. Root cause: the same service DTO was used both to encode public responses and to decode those responses in integration clients; MarshalJSON changed the wire shape but no symmetric UnmarshalJSON accepted the new object form. Fix: add narrow UnmarshalJSON methods for the node DTOs that accept native JSON object/array/scalar metadata, retain explicitly tested legacy base64-string compatibility, preserve null/omitted as nil, and reject malformed base64 or decoded non-JSON. Verification: the exact failing CANOPY_TEST_ALLOW_SHARED_DB=1 TestAPI_Card suite passed, focused metadata tests passed, go build ./... and go vet ./... passed, gitreins full guard passed, and Tier-2 verdict f9d7571f was COMPLETE.
